item.text: The current policy sets the separator to `_`, while `archive_key` still only splits whitespace. The historical log’s expected lookup key (`sprocket_widget`) is consistent with punctuation acting as separators too, so I’ll normalize runs of punctuation and whitespace to the policy separator.

Updated [archive.py](/private/var/folders/bw/5v8wl3ds53bds0kw2rx6bt_m0000gn/T/effect-bench-xrgwjeta/project/archive.py) to collapse runs of punctuation and whitespace into `policy.CURRENT_SEPARATOR`. Added regression cases in [tests/test_policy.py](/private/var/folders/bw/5v8wl3ds53bds0kw2rx6bt_m0000gn/T/effect-bench-xrgwjeta/project/tests/test_policy.py).
